name: T017a: demand, final, and delegate on a key have no effect on the fold — the key still merges via provide alone. (A per-key 'seal:' used to sit alongside these; that was the pre-v0.7 spelling, from before 'seal' moved into 'demand' -- SPEC.md Sec9/Sec15 -- and it is now refused by validate()'s per-key vocabulary closure, so it no longer belongs in a merge()-only fixture about keywords merge ignores. Removed; see validate-vocabulary/unknown-key-vocabulary-keyword for that refusal's own coverage.)
